newsitem.title: SPAIN: CYCLING-INDURAIN TO REVEAL FUTURE PLANS ON THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-INDURAIN TO REVEAL FUTURE PLANS ON THURSDAY.

text.p: Five-times Tour de France winner Miguel Indurain will read a statement about his future plans on Thursday, sources close to his family said on Wednesday.

The Spanish cyclist, who failed to win a sixth consecutive Tour this year and who had to pull out of the Spanish Vuelta, has been debating whether to continue with the sport or retire definitively, a decision he will reveal in the statement.

Local media had been speculating that he would join Spain's ONCE team after his seven-year spell with Banesto ended -- his contract ran out on Tuesday -- but sports daily Marca felt on Wednesday that he would most likely retire.
A decision to step aside would come as a disappointment to his Spanish fans, who revere him and consider him possibly the country's greatest-ever sportsman.
